posts.title: Third Shower – First Stream
posts.description: Triṭīya-vṛṣṭi (Third Shower) Mukhya-vidhi vā Vaidhī-bhaktira Sādhāraṇa Vicāra (A General Analysis of the Primary Rules, or Vaidhī-bhakti) Prathama-Dhārā (First Stream) The Characteristics of Vaidhi-bhakti The dharma that arises from śāstrika injunctions is called vaidhi-dharma . Vaidhi-dharma is of two kinds – ārthika (or traivargika vaidhi-dharma ) , and pāramārthika (or āpavargika vaidhi-dharma ) . That dharma in which the three divisions of dharma, artha and kāma are found is called traivargika-dharma . It promotes only the development of the body, mind, society and a life governed by morality, and it also awards the happiness of Svarga in the next life. The happiness of Svarga is temporary. After enjoying it, the jīva returns once again to the field of action ( karma-kṣetra ). The varṇāśrama-dharma which was previously explained is, in reality, ārthika (meant for material prosperity). Dharma, artha and kāma continue to revolve in a cycle. Through this, the jīva does not become free

posts.title: Ādi-Līlā Chapter Nine
posts.description: Ādi-Līlā Chapter Eight A Summary of the Ninth Chapter In the Ninth Chapter, the author has introduced a mystery by describing bhakti in the form of a tree. He has described Viśvambhara Gaurāṅga as the original tree, and as the gardener of the tree of bhakti , as well as the giver and enjoyer of its fruits. The planting of this fruit-bearing tree began in Śrī Navadvīpa-dhāma. Later, orchards of the fruits of prema of this kind were cultivated in other places, such as Puruṣottama and Vṛndāvana. Śrī Mādhavendra Purī was the first sprout of this tree, and his disciple, Śrī Īśvara Purī, nourished that sprout. Mahāprabhu Śrī Caitanyadeva became the gardener and, by the power of His own inconceivable potency, also became the trunk of the tree. Nine sannyāsīs , including Paramānanda Purī, were the roots of this tree. Above the original trunk, two further trunks appeared in the forms of Śrī Advaita and Śrī Nityānanda. posts.title: Second Shower – Fifth Stream
posts.description: Dvitīya-vṛṣṭi (Second Shower) Pañcama-dhārā (Fifth Stream) Daily Duties Rising at the brāhma-muhūrta , one shall thoughtfully determine all the spiritual and worldly tasks that are to be accomplished throughout the day and night. In the early morning, one shall deposit bodily waste at a proper place not contrary to the rules of physical hygiene, and cleanse the mouth, arms, and all the sense-organs. One shall bathe in clean and pure water and put on appropriate clothing and the like. Thereafter, one shall gather wealth by adopting means of earning money approved by the śāstra . Taking into account the condition of one’s body, one shall bathe at midday and perform worship of the Supreme as well as tarpaṇa and the like. When food and other provisions are prepared, one shall set aside a small portion for all living beings and something for the fallen and the undeserving, and then stand in the courtyard of the house with the intention of receiving a guest.
